description.value: Pho 99 Vietnamese Noodle House is a Vietnamese restaurant on North Road in Coquitlam offering dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering including tourist group meals. The menu focuses on pho and authentic Vietnamese cuisine. It sits in a multi-unit commercial building in a busy urban corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, phone (604-939-2288), and address (302-403 North Rd, Coquitlam, BC V3K 3V9). Takeout is explicitly stated on the website ('Dine-in or Take-Out', 'Dine In, Pickup, Delivery'). No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities; the website content is extremely sparse (SEO text only). The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the address is clearly Coquitlam.
concerns: OSM community/location field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website address is clearly Coquitlam, BC — possible geographic mis-assignment in the OSM data.
Website content is extremely sparse (933 bytes, SEO/header text only); no substantive page content was available to verify amenities.
OSM address fields are incomplete (only addr:unit=302 present); full address sourced from website.

A direct visit or follow-up with the business is needed to confirm eligibility.
